title: Intro page blocks
description: Allowed block types for an intro (splash/redirect) page. Like audio/image/document pages, an intro page is a free-composition block array — the builder seeds it with logo_section/description_box/auto_redirect (add-page-sheet.tsx INITIAL_BLOCKS) — but unlike those, the enum here is DELIBERATELY narrow (branding, short text, one action/redirect, a divider) rather than the near-full block set: an intro screen is a splash shown before real content, not a place for maps/forms/RSVP/menus/etc. Per-block `data` still dispatches via ../block-item.json. Supersedes an earlier revision of this file that made `intro` a locked, non-block page type storing {logoUrl,tagline,time,redirect} directly on `data` — reverted in favor of this block-based model so intro pages get the same layout flexibility (reorder, restyle, add/remove) as every other page type.
